hero.title: Compute and explain an Italian payslip, according to the CCNL.
hero.sub: Gross, net and employer cost from versioned rules, with sources and explicit limits.
examples.title: Examples
example.full_time.title: Full time, new hire
example.full_time.why: A full-time permanent hire with no seniority: the metalworking agreement has a production ruleset, with verified CCNL rules.
example.part_time.title: Part time with seniority
example.part_time.why: Shows part-time scaling, the seniority increments of six years and the fourteen monthly payments of Commerce.
example.apprentice.title: Apprenticeship
example.apprentice.why: Shows the apprentice pay halfway through the track and the lower contribution cost for the employer.
example.domestic.title: Domestic work
example.domestic.why: A different regime: hourly INPS contributions and no IRPEF withholding, because a household employer is not a withholding agent.
form.title: Your scenario
form.ccnl.label: CCNL
form.ccnl.tip: The national collective agreement: it sets minimum pay, seniority increments, extra monthly payments and allowances.
form.level.label: Level
form.level.tip: The worker's grade in the CCNL.
form.contract.label: Contract type
form.contract.tip: A fixed-term contract adds the additional NASpI contribution; an apprenticeship applies the pay of the CCNL track.
form.parttime.label: Part time
form.parttime.tip: Share of full time: it scales base pay, seniority and allowances.
form.apprentice.months_tip: Months since the apprenticeship started, used for the whole year computed.
form.apprentice.track_tip: The CCNL has several tracks for this level: choose one.
form.seniority.label: Months of service on 1 January
form.seniority.tip: Recognised seniority at the start of the year: the engine derives the increments month by month. When empty, increments are left out and the result says so.
form.employees.label: Employer headcount
form.employees.tip: It selects the INPS rates and the contributions tied to company size.
form.regione.label: Region of residence
form.regione.tip: Needed for the regional IRPEF surtax.
form.comune.label: Municipality of residence
form.comune.tip: Needed for the municipal IRPEF surtax.
form.fulltime.label: Full-time weekly hours
form.fulltime.tip: The full time of the contract: with the part-time share it sets the weekly hours.
form.ivs.label: First enrolled with INPS from 1996
form.ivs.tip: For workers enrolled from 1 January 1996, IVS contributions stop at the annual ceiling (L. 335/1995 art. 2 c. 18).
form.error.level: Choose a CCNL and a level.
form.error.headcount: The headcount must be at least 1.
form.error.seniority: Months of service cannot be negative.
results.stale: You changed the inputs: calculate again.
kpi.net_sub: {annual} in the year over {runs} monthly payments
kpi.explain: The engine computes all {runs} monthly payments of {year}. The monthly gross is December: base pay, seniority and allowances. The net takes the INPS contributions and IRPEF off the gross of the year and adds the tax credits. The employer cost adds the employer contributions and the TFR to the gross.
kpi.explain_domestic: The engine computes all {runs} monthly payments of {year}. The monthly gross is December. The net takes only the worker's contributions off the gross of the year: a household employer withholds no IRPEF. The employer cost adds the employer contributions and the TFR.
reliability.ruleset.production: The rules of this CCNL are verified.
reliability.ruleset.reviewed: The rules of this CCNL were reviewed but are not in production yet.
reliability.ruleset.exploratory: The rules of this CCNL were extracted and not reviewed yet: check the amounts against the sources.
reliability.ruleset.untracked: This CCNL does not state how its rules were checked.
reliability.payable: The result can be paid as is.
reliability.estimate: Pay, contributions and taxes are computed, but the result is an estimate: some individual facts were not given ({n} blockers in the technical details).
reliability.omissions: Facts that can change the amounts:
reliability.omission.seniority: Seniority: without the months of service, increments are left out.
reliability.omission.residence: Residence: without region and municipality the IRPEF surtaxes are not determined.
reliability.omission.family: Dependants: no family deductions are applied.
reliability.omission.perequativo: Elemento perequativo: without the second-level bargaining of the employer and the pay above the CCNL of the year before, it is not included.
reliability.omission.contribution_histor: First INPS enrolment: needed above the contribution ceiling.
reliability.omission.other_income: Other income of the year: IRPEF considers this employment only.

scope.title: Reliability: technical details
scope.note: Each blocker has a stable code, the feature it concerns and a detail. A result is payable only without blockers.
breakdown.title: Annual breakdown
breakdown.note.domestic: A household employer is not a withholding agent: the worker pays IRPEF through the tax return, so the net does not subtract it.
breakdown.note.surtax: The regional and municipal surtaxes on this year's income are withheld from the next year: they do not appear in this breakdown.
